title: Sample a charge-projected Gaussian component without rare-sector rejection
statement: The source gives chi(z)=2^-n Pf[(1+z)J+(z-1)Gamma]. Coefficients w_q are charge probabilities; sequential occupation branches use p_x*w_(q-x)(Gamma_prime)/w_q(Gamma) with the actual Gaussian update. This avoids rejection1/w_q within a supplied component and supports the stated number-conserving Gaussian instruments.

requires: Actual Gaussian covariance or efficiently sampled component and exact charge, specified number-conserving instrument family
provides: A terminal occupation sampler and qualified Gaussian-instrument update on one projected component
assumptions: No arbitrary pairing feedback or non-Gaussian operation
Outer component weights must be reweighted separately; numerical branch precision is paid
costs: Within-component O(n^5) exact arithmetic or paid improved Pfaffian implementation, rational/precision costs
Outer rejection/second-moment/mixing costs remain unacquired; finite-bit trajectory implementation separate
contract.units: Exact charge probabilities and rational arithmetic; covariance convention Gamma_ab=i Tr(rho gamma_a gamma_b).
contract.obstruction: Failure of positive Gaussian geometry does not imply failure of every constructive receiver.

evidence.quote: ## 3. A direct receiver that does not require projected Gaussianity
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The conditional component receiver does not acquire the outer reweighted mixture p_q(a) proportional to p(a)w_q(a). Fixed-charge projection, existence of a positive mixture and an efficient acquired mixture sampler are distinct. The threshold is sector/model-specific and is not a lower bound against every classical simulation. No broad new Gibbs-sampling or hardware advantage was acquired. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Actual supplied derivations are available. No separate completed independent review of these new stages was delivered; prior accepted trajectory-cone results retain their own scope.
